home.title: Biodiversity Evaluation Engine
home.description: The Biodiversity Evaluation Engine is an open tool aiming to enhance the capacity of Biodiversity Observation Networks and countries to report on biodiversity effectively. It connects individual analyses scripts into automated pipelines that convert data into Essential Biodiversity Variables (EBVs) and indicators. These community-built pipelines can analyze public or user datasets, and can be shared for auditability, reproducibility, and transparency.

stac.helpIntro: A STAC catalog is an online library of maps and satellite images. Work from top to bottom:
stac.helpCatalog: Catalog: pick one from the list, or paste the web address of another catalog.
stac.helpCollection: Collection: pick a dataset. Open its description to learn what it contains.
stac.helpDate: Date: if the collection covers several dates, pick one.
stac.helpItem: Item: pick one file from the list. Type in the filter box to search by name. If the collection is split into tiles, tick “Mosaic” to use all of them as one layer instead.
stac.helpAsset: Asset: pick the layer you need, such as a band or a variable. Tick “Categorical” if its values are classes (land cover types, for example) rather than measurements.
stac.helpPreview: Use Preview to check the layer, then Add to selection. Repeat for as many layers as you need.
stac.helpFinish: When you are done, press Accept. Clear empties the selection, and Cancel closes the window without changes.
